about.heading: About Me
about.body: A detail-oriented lawyer with 5+ years of experience focusing on corporate, labor, and regulatory laws. Proven expertise in providing strategic legal advice to businesses, drafting, and reviewing a wide range of legal documents. Strong track record in ensuring organizational compliance with company laws, industry laws, labor laws, and sector-specific regulations. An ordinary member at the Nepal Council of Arbitration (NEPCA) since October 2024.
memberships: Nepal Council of Arbitration (NEPCA) — Ordinary Member since October 2024

roles.title: Legal and Compliance Officer
responsibilities: Draft and submit amendments to the Specialized Investment Fund (SIF) Regulation to the Regulatory Authority.
Review and update internal policies, including HR, Code of Conducts, and Risk Management frameworks.
Ensure AML compliance through timely quarterly and biannual reporting.
Draft and review contracts, MOUs, and legal correspondences.
Effective communication with international teams, consultants, and internal departments.
Review PEVC fund structuring documents (Fund Constitution, Offer Document, and Investment Agreement) for regulatory approval.
Perform Company Secretary duties, including drafting Board minutes, managing AGM/EGM, and preparing the Annual Report.
Maintain corporate structuring and ensure compliance with prevailing laws and regulations.

experience.company: National Path Labs and Research Centre Pvt. Ltd.

roles.title: Company Secretary
responsibilities: Advised the Board on corporate governance, statutory compliance, and regulatory obligations.
Ensured the compliance with applicable laws through timely filings and maintenance of statutory records.
Organized and managed Board Meetings, AGM, and EGM in accordance with legal and procedural requirements.
Drafted and maintained minutes and official resolutions of Board and shareholder meetings.
Monitored and ensured implementation of Board and Shareholder decisions.
Acted as the key liaison between the Board, Management, Shareholders, and Regulatory Authorities.
Circulated meeting notices, agendas, and relevant documentation in a timely and confidential manner.
Maintained corporate records and safeguarded official company documentation.
